svg.title: Repository API export contract demo
svg.desc: A static walkthrough of the manifest, API coverage, export bundle, and CLI plan produced by the module.
svg.text: Programmatic access and export-bundle readiness for SCIBASE project repositories

g.text: Required components: manuscript, data, code, notebooks, results, protocols, metadata
Integrity root: sha256 over component hashes and reproducibility evidence
Public scoped GET, POST, and PUT routes are required
Export route must include the manifest integrity root
Includes manifest, API contract, reproducibility runbook, citation metadata, and files
Bundle hash signs ordered entry paths and hashes
clone, status, export, and route discovery commands
Designed for labs that want Git-compatible automation

svg.text: Validation: npm test; npm run demo
